headline: Code Changes & Accelerated Review goes before Planning Commission Meeting on Thursday, September 10
blurb: Three Land Use Code amendments are on the table for the Planning Commission's recommendation — covering forestry practices, oil and gas, and geothermal energy. All three are code-change items, meaning the Commission is being asked to weigh in before any revisions move forward to the BOCC.
